environment.description: Deployed on EKS with Thales Luna Network HSM 7.x (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validated, certificate #3545). Partition policy enforces CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false and CKA_SENSITIVE=true on all key objects; the partition's Crypto Officer role has 'Allow key export' set to 0 in the partition policy template. The PKCS#11 provider is configured with partition-level access control requiring mutual TLS client certificate authentication between the application pod and the HSM appliance. Pod runs with read-only root filesystem under a non-root securityContext (runAsUser: 65534). However, the format string vulnerability in the application code remains — user-supplied label values are still concatenated into format strings before String.format() is called. The HSM's audit logging captures all C_Sign, C_Encrypt, C_Decrypt, C_WrapKey, C_UnwrapKey calls with full PKCS#11 mechanism parameters but does NOT inspect or filter application-layer request content.

config.network_policy: deny-all-ingress except port 8443 from internal ALB
